title: October 23, 2022: India's heaviest rocket flew its first paying customer.

sources.text: ISRO - Joint press release by ISRO, NSIL and OneWeb
Al Jazeera - India launches into orbit 36 internet satellites

caption:
October 23, 2022: India's heaviest rocket flew its first paying customer.

It was the first fully commercial launch of LVM3 - India's heaviest-lift rocket, normally reserved for government missions - arranged through NewSpace India Limited, ISRO's commercial arm.

The mission marked India's entry into the global commercial launch services market - a rocket built for the country's own missions now earning revenue by flying someone else's payload.

Turning India's heaviest rocket into a commercial product - available to any customer, not just the government - showed a path for the space program to fund itself.
